report_topic: Land Acquisition and Allotment of Properties in Greater Noida Industrial Development Authority (GNIDA)
observations_summary: The audit found significant lapses in planning, land acquisition, pricing, and allotment of properties by GNIDA, leading to a loss of ₹13,362 crore and overdue payments of ₹19,500 crore. Issues included misuse of urgency clauses for land acquisition, arbitrary fixation of sale prices, and failure to ensure project completion, with many industrial and housing projects remaining incomplete.
